conclusions: The whole disc took 26.7 minutes (1605 s) at an average of 723.5 KiB/s, with 0 retries and 0 failed, mismatched, guarded or refused reads in 15797 requests.

Trip 5a predicted 27.4 minutes for track 3 from the inner-edge bench; it took 26.6 (-2.7%). The time split matched the bench's: SD write 63.8%, disc 27.3%, CRC32 5.6%, EDC 2.8% (bench: 64 / 27 / 5.8 / 2.9).
Against the old defaults' rate from Trip 5a this is about 3.9x faster (an estimate of 105 minutes; no old-default run of this disc was timed).

Two independent checks agree. On the console, the CRC32 accumulated while reading matches the TOSEC catalogue for every track, so the disc was read correctly. On the PC, every saved file matches the CRC32 the console recorded (SAVED DATA VERIFIED) and the SHA-256 values match the reference for tracks 1-2.

All three tracks are byte-identical (SHA-256, CRC32 and size) to the capture made on 2026-09-17 with SHA-256 and a full read-back: [True, True, True]. That also corroborates that capture's track 3 SHA-256, which had only been computed by the console.
The console did not re-read the saved tracks; the PC check is what covers the path from memory to the card.

limitations: One disc, one card, one console, one capture. The reference step's SHA-256 covers tracks 1-2 only (track 3's reference entry is CRC32 plus size); track 3's SHA-256 equality is against the 2026-09-17 capture.
